details:
People in certain groups should be denied access to the main group instances that the owner has certain groups blocked. <prevents crasher and hackers from ever joining. >this could upset people but its so worth implementing imagine all those hostel groups that are still up preventing its members from coming in and crashing everyone.

Basically cant join the instance unless they are not in that group. Or unless the main group that the player uses doesn't have that group blocked.

example: potato group: i host it and i dont want laughing coffin joining: i simply block that group from the groups page and then there members cant join.

The thing people worry about with this is that this is less likely to impact the player base on vrchat. people will be able to play with a ease of mind knowing that people won't cause problems.

avatar global group instance hiding. this is a admin staff moderation thing that I thought of:

you would open your menu and click on a players collider. You would then scroll down above the warn kick force mute and ban buttons there would be this hide avatar instance. what that would do is when any player joins the instance with that avatar it would globally hide that avatar for everyone that way it would prevent crashers from crashing everyone in the instance. This would be a major fix for a lot of groups. its like that hide avatar for everyone on your side but for group instances and and its only hidden for everyone that is in that instance. its a pretty smart moderation to add.

example: I am hanging out with my friends and a crasher joins and a few players actually have there shield set to none. They almost crash but i press hide avatar instance and it hides that crashers avatar for everyone and no one crashes.

the avatar hiding would reset with each instance or if the devs wanted it would keep hiding them until the button is pressed again.

Tupper how close are we to have full on group 18+ verification? I actually want to know please.
title: Group menu/settings safety features
